id: title:MattPua:restore contrast on recommended tag in quill customize menu

review.posthog_relevance: Dashboard customization menu rendering and styling preservation
review.reason: Adds a wrapper span with `data-not-quill` and `contents` class around a LemonTag, while removing the LemonTag's direct parent span. This targets the Dashboard customization menu, specifically the compaction option labels, to prevent Quill editor's popover styles from interfering with the visual appearance of the 'Recommended' tag.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is inferred from the comment and hunk description; no runtime behavior or test results are supplied to verify the conflict actually occurred or was resolved. The score is conservative, treating this as a localized maintenance/styling correction rather than a systemic improvement.

observations.behavior: Adds a wrapper span with data-not-quill and contents class around a LemonTag, while removing the LemonTag's direct parent span. Adds a comment explaining that Lemon tags use --success, which Quill redefines as a pale fill inside popovers.
observations.posthog_connection: This change targets the Dashboard customization menu, specifically the compaction option labels. It addresses a potential rendering or styling conflict where the Quill editor's popover styles might interfere with the visual appearance of the 'Recommended' tag, likely by preventing Quill's style injection or DOM manipulation from affecting this specific element.
